verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS invoicing product, but the evidence pack never mentions retention settings, data deletion, account or organization purge, or export-then-delete workflows. The only privacy-adjacent item covers security features (PCI-DSS, SSL encryption, two-factor authentication), which is a different capability from retention control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
